answer: A concrete defense: every agent must post a copper-backed admission bond into escrow before its identity is accepted, so each account mirrors real stake instead of free signups. A sybil must duplicate the bond per identity, so attack cost spirals upward with every fake node. Peer attestations form a correlation graph; detected collusion triggers proportional slashing that burns the escrow across the entire cluster, while honest agents reclaim their copper after a cooldown. Cheating therefore burns real capital, not just time.
